evals.prompt: Piattaforma: Claude Code. Compito: ogni lunedì prendo l'export CSV delle vendite della settimana (vendite_settimana.csv) e scrivo a mano un report markdown con i totali per categoria e i 5 prodotti migliori. Voglio una skill che lo faccia.
evals.expected_output: A new standalone git repository named after the task, outside any other repository, with skills/<name>/SKILL.md (portable frontmatter, Italian trigger phrases in the description), at least three evals, an Italian README with Claude Code install steps and official source links, MIT LICENSE, .gitignore and AGENTS.md. The validator reports 0 errors, the work is committed locally, and the reply is the five-part report in Italian.
assertions: The new repository contains README.md, LICENSE, .gitignore, AGENTS.md and skills/<name>/SKILL.md
Running the repository's scripts/validate_skill.py reports 0 errors
The SKILL.md frontmatter uses only name, description, license, compatibility, metadata or allowed-tools
The reply has five parts headed PARTE 1 to PARTE 5
The reply lists at least one official documentation URL for Claude Code
The repository has a local commit and no remote

evals.prompt: I use ChatGPT at work. Every time a customer emails a complaint I rewrite a polite reply that follows our refund policy (30 days, receipt required). Make me a skill for that.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks OpenAI's official documentation before building, and states clearly which ChatGPT surfaces and plans support skills and what it could not confirm. It then creates the standalone repository with a portable skill for drafting refund-policy replies and delivers the five-part report in English.
assertions: The reply cites OpenAI documentation URLs
Any ChatGPT capability that could not be confirmed is labelled as unverified rather than stated as fact
The skill's description is in third person and contains a 'Use when' clause
The SKILL.md contains the refund policy details given in the prompt

evals.prompt: crea una skill per rinominare le foto dei clienti
evals.expected_output: The agent asks one question, for the missing platform, and creates no files until the user answers.
assertions: The reply asks which platform or agent the user works with
No repository or file is created in this turn
The reply does not ask for details that can be derived later, such as the skill name
